# Speedtest Tracker Home Assistant Add-on Repository

This is the official Home Assistant Add-on repository for [Speedtest Tracker](https://github.com/alexjustesen/speedtest-tracker).

## Quick Start

1. Add this repository to Home Assistant:
   ```
   https://github.com/yourusername/hassio-speedtest-tracker
   ```

2. Install the "Speedtest Tracker" add-on

3. Start the add-on

4. Access it at: `http://homeassistant.local:8000`

## What's Included

- **Speedtest Tracker Add-on**: Full Docker image for monitoring internet performance
- **Easy Installation**: One-click installation from Home Assistant UI
- **Persistent Data**: All data is stored in `/config/speedtest-tracker/`
- **Web Interface**: Access your speedtest results anytime

## Architecture Support

- ✅ amd64 (Intel/AMD 64-bit)
- ✅ aarch64 (ARM 64-bit / Raspberry Pi 4+)
- ✅ armv7 (ARM 32-bit / Raspberry Pi 3+)

## Requirements

- Home Assistant OS or Supervised
- 500MB+ free storage
- 1GB+ RAM recommended
